description: Per-trailer tonnage for a rail weight declaration; the first message never says which consignment. DISTILL-CANARY-08b3e97a

turns.prompt: Pellworthy Kaolin's dispatcher is filling in the weight declaration for the rail depot and needs a per-trailer figure. How many tonnes does each trailer carry?

It is the Barrowford consignment, 48 tonnes of kaolin split evenly over 6 trailers. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
